title: BrowsePage: Genre filter (native select)
goal: Add the Genre filter to the catalogue. Use a native <label htmlFor> plus <select>, passed as ListPage's toolbar. The page needs 'use client' and React state for the chosen genre. There is no paging yet: list every matching book.
spec: BRW-4: A control labelled "Genre" offers All genres, Fiction, History and Science; picking a genre shows only that genre's books and goes back to the first page, and All genres shows every book again.
